# requirements_nimcosipy.txt
# Runtime: Python 3.12
#
# Environment for BGO non-imaging localization tasks. It combines the COSIpy
# runtime, bc-tools localization dependencies, and the local cosipy.nonimaging
# checkout mounted inside the Airflow container.

# Packaging compatibility: legacy dependencies still import pkg_resources.
setuptools==80.9.0

# Conservative scientific stack shared with the COSIpy/BCT environments.
numpy>=1.24,<2
scipy>=1.10,<=1.15.3
matplotlib>=3.7.1,<3.9
pandas>=2.0,<2.2
h5py>=3
pyyaml

# Runtime utilities used by COSIpy.
psutil
py7zr

# Core runtime packages.
-e git+https://github.com/cositools/cosipy.git@develop#egg=cosipy
git+https://gitlab.com/burstcube/bc-tools.git@develop

# Official cositools repository. The BGO localizer is currently provided by
# pull request #2; pin its current commit to keep installs reproducible. This
# is intentionally non-editable: pip builds it without retaining a VCS checkout
# under the managed virtual environment.
cosipy.nonimaging @ git+https://github.com/cositools/cosipy.nonimaging.git@7d55da4ff2fb89da0d97ae6aea2da8563277ab5d
